response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), t AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT t.archstat, t.cnt AS record_count, t.share AS share, t.share - a.avg_share AS share_above_average FROM t, a WHERE t.share > a.avg_share
